failure_reason: Planned temporal refinement was not met; retain both trajectories and revise explicitly

temporal_refinement_scope.interpretation: Both passes share their first 14 accepted steps through 0.16 ps. The maximum-step bounds 0.1 ps and 0.05 ps then separate the grids. Only observations 0.3 ps and 1 ps compare distinct trajectories; this is not a systematic convergence-order study.

implementation_observation.recommendation: Future drivers should identify the observation endpoint within floating-point rounding and avoid a redundant last 1.11e-16 ps step; original results are retained.

plot_metadata.physical_case: Fixed bath T=0.9 K, Tc=8.65 K; 65x65 graph vortex-core control on square [-6,6] ell0 in x and y, spacing 0.1875 ell0 and 256 fixed boundary nodes; 256 Matsubara terms; no photon, no strip experiment and no circuit trajectory.
plot_metadata.baseline: d_b(t) is the unperturbed evolving core. It is not stationary and is subtracted at the same time.
plot_metadata.amplitude_probe: Initial d_A-d_b = 0.001 d0 b(r), b=max(0,1-r^2/R^2)^3; R=4 ell0 from admitted operator plan.
plot_metadata.angular_phase_probe: Initial d_P-d_b = 0.001 i d0 (x/R) b(r). Cartesian perturbation, not a global phase shift.
plot_metadata.node_norm: ||z||_M=sqrt(sum_i m_i |z_i|^2), including fixed nodes, m_i dimensionless cell area.
plot_metadata.current_norm: ||j||=sqrt(sum_edges_positive_c j_e^2/c_e), c_e graph conductance in dimensionless action.
plot_metadata.displacement: d=Delta/(k_B Tc). Curve: ||d_probe(t)-d_b(t)||_M / ||d_probe(0)-d_b(0)||_M; unitless, not a point amplitude.
plot_metadata.force_density: q_i=G_i/m_i, where G is discrete thermal free-energy gradient. Curve uses probe-minus-base force; dimensionless variational density, not newtons.
plot_metadata.phase_torque_density: tau_i=Im(conj(d_i) G_i)/m_i. Curve uses tau_probe-tau_base; dimensionless force for condensate phase, not mechanical torque.
plot_metadata.current: Derivative of the same dimensionless spectral action with respect to edge gauge link. Probe-minus-base graph current; no ampere conversion is asserted.
plot_metadata.time: Real physical time in ps; tau=t/[hbar/(2 k_B Tc)] is internal solver time only.
plot_metadata.refinement: Primary minus refined trajectory in the same observable and norm. Original gate: error <= 1e-8 + 0.005 max(initial norm, remaining refined norm).
plot_metadata.contextual_scale: Maximum initial amplitude/phase signal for the SAME observable. A diagnostic contextualization, not a replacement gate.
plot_metadata.free_energy: Change in dimensionless finite-Matsubara thermal free-energy action from d0 at fixed bath. It is not conserved internal energy.
plot_metadata.plots_must_distinguish: Response magnitude, refinement difference, and remaining-signal denominator. State which field, probe, norm, normalization, units and baseline appear in each caption.
